statement.text:
By definition two elements g1 and g2 of a free metabelian group F with
basis {x1 , . . . , xn } have the same distribution if the equations g1 (x1 , . . . , xn ) = g and
g2 (x1 , . . . , xn ) = g have the same number of solutions in any finite metabelian group
G for every g ∈ G. Is it true that elements g1 and g2 have the same distribution if
and only if they are conjugate by some automorphism of F ?                   E. I. Timoshenko
